reason: A is marginally better because it proposes nanoscale ordering or fine precipitates while explicitly constraining the treatment to avoid brittle intermetallic formation and grain coarsening; B’s continuous or semi-continuous B2 phase is likely to dominate deformation through embrittlement and largely repeats the cited refractory-HEA result. Both remain under-specified, however, because they conflate LCO with precipitation, give no precise heat treatment or quantitative effect threshold, and do not fully isolate ordering from other heat-treatment-induced changes.
